title: Mixed Media & Collage
welcome_lead: Combine paper, paint, print and found things.
meta_desc: KS3 mixed media: collage, layering, found materials.
final_note: Mix media to make work nobody else could.

concepts.def: Artwork made by sticking materials together.
Using more than one medium in a work.
Adding media on top of each other.

walkthroughs.body_html: Collage comes from the French 'coller' meaning 'to glue'. Picasso and Braque pioneered it in 1912 by gluing newspaper into Cubist paintings.
True mixed media might start with a printed photo, painted layers, drawn ink lines and stitched thread. Allow each layer to dry or set before adding the next.
Bus tickets, fabric scraps, leaves — anything can be a found object. Artists like Hannah Höch built famous photomontages from cut-up magazines.
